jobs_results.title: Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Our client is a pioneering company specializing in database management solutions that utilize a hybrid approach, integrating the strengths of both SQL and NoSQL technologies. This approach supports scalable, high-performance, and real-time data processing, tailored for handling both transactional and analytical workloads. With a commitment to ensuring full transaction compliance and efficient scalability, their technology facilitates seamless data operations. It is ideally suited for industries in need of real-time analytics and robust support for extensive application deployments, thereby catering to the complexities of data-intensive applications.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in integrating, delivering, or building world-class software, preferably within a rapidly expanding tech startup environment. This role is crucial for migrating current applications to a new, advanced database system, optimizing SQL performance, troubleshooting system... issues, enhancing integration with third-party vendors, and facilitating knowledge transfer regarding best practices for database use.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain scalable and efficient backend services using Python

Perform SQL and PL/SQL optimization to enhance system performance.

Lead migration projects from various database managers to a new, cutting-edge database system, ensuring minimal impact and maximal efficiency.

Troubleshoot and resolve critical system issues, offering deep technical insights.

Improve data integration and modelling with third-party vendors using ETLs, BI, and CDCs.

Conduct knowledge transfer sessions on the use of the new database system and its best practices.

Collaborate with teams to innovate and deliver superior database solutions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

3+ years of experience in software integration, delivery, or development, with a preference for experience in a fast-growing tech startup.

Expertise in SQL optimization and backend development with Python.

Familiarity with ETLs, BI tools, CDCs, and integrating data from third-party vendors.

Proficiency in cloud services (AWS, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker).

Demonstrated experience in database migration projects, with a willingness to learn and adapt to new database technologies.

Exceptional problem-solving abilities and troubleshooting skills.

Effective communication skills for knowledge transfer and collaborative teamwork.

WHAT OUR CLIENT OFFER

Competitive Salary: Based on experience.

Paid Holidays: 23 days plus bank holidays.

Remote Work Flexibility: Fully remote operation with the option to work from home or travel to the office as agreed with the team.

Flexible Working Hours: Tailor your work schedule to your needs.

Learning & Development: Emphasized with training courses on relevant topics like transactions, SQL query processing, and storage.

Private Health Insurance: For your health and well-being

jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Experience Remote done Right. With over 20 years of remote experience, all 500+ staff are 100% remote and we still grow vibrant relationships, and provide exceptional opportunities for career growth while working with stellar clients on ambitious projects

What we're working on:

Enterprise companies turn to us to help them launch innovative digital products that interact with hundreds of millions of customers, transactions and data points. The problems we solve every day are real and require creativity, grit and determination. We are building a culture that challenges norms while fostering experimentation and personal growth. In order to grasp the scale of problems we face, ideally, you have some exposure to Logistics, FinTech, Transportation, Insurance, Media or other complex multifactor industries

Requirements:
• 7+ years experience in a senior developer role; ideally, you have delivered business-critical software to large enterprises
• 4+ years hands-on experience with the Django... framework
• Experience with Power BI, PowerApps, and Azure
• Previous experience with Django rest Framework will be advantageous
• Ability to craft new API specifications and develop to provided specifications
• Ability to think about long-term maintenance when creating or making changes
• English fluency, verbal and written
• Professional, empathic, team player
• Problem solver, proactive, go-getter

This position is 100% remote. Contract hiring is over C2C - Overlap with EST timezone will be required.

Why Lumenalta is an amazing place to work at

At Lumenalta, you can expect that you will:
• Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can innovate and grow.
• Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior-level developers.
• Work on projects that allow you to use leading tech.

The result? We produce meaningful outcomes for our clients that break barriers in their industries. The job is 100% remote; please ensure you have a comfortable office setup at your desired work location

jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Are you a Senior Python Developer with focus on Image Processing seeking a new interesting challenge? 🔍

If your answer is yes, it’s your lucky day so keep reading, it can be just what you're looking for! 👀

✍️ WHAT WILL YOU DO?

We are looking for a dynamic, proactive and talented person to join our team and perform the following tasks:
• Independently manage projects and enhancements related to medical imaging and computer vision.
• Demonstrate strong project management skills and the ability to lead initiatives.
• Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
• Proactively handle support handover and efficiently manage operations.
• Utilize Python for developing and implementing solutions in medical imaging and computer vision.
• Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools like Terraform and GitLab action.
• Apply expertise in medical image formats such as DICOM and nifti for data analysis.
• Preferred practical knowledge or hands-on experience with Flywheel... product.
• Utilize TensorFlow and PyTorch for advanced image processing tasks.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of algorithms for medical image analysis.
• Collaborate with life sciences professionals to understand domain-specific requirements and challenges

🧐 WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR IN YOU?
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Native Spanish Language and Advanced level of English
• Strong proficiency in Python programming language.
• Experience with CI/CD pipeline tools like Terraform and GitLab action.
• Knowledge of medical image formats (e.g., DICOM, nifti) and image analysis techniques.
• Practical experience with Flywheel product is a plus.
• Familiarity with TensorFlow and PyTorch for deep learning applications.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Proactive attitude towards support handover and operations management.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a team environment.
• Experience in the life sciences industry is desirable.

📅 WHERE AND WHEN?
• Workplace: San Blas-Canillejas, 28037 Madrid + Remote work (Hybrid model)
• Work Schedule: Business Hours

🤝 WHAT CAN WE OFFER YOU?
• Permanent contract 📋 - We offer indefinite contracts from the first day.
• Pay and benefits 💸 - Competitive salary and a flexible compensation plan adapted to your needs (Ticket restaurant plan, Childcare Ticket, Transport Ticket and Health Insurance).
• Work from home 🏚️ - We offer you a financial support every month for your working from home expenses. In addition, in the first month we will give you a bonus to help you to set up your workplace 👨💻
• Opportunity knocks 👍🏻 - Being a part of a growing company, we want to support your path with a career development plan and annual performance-based compensation reviews.
• Learn as you grow 📚 - Starting with a fantastic onboarding program, TCS has robust learning platforms that will allow you to learn and grow personal as professionally.
• Bring your buddy 👫 - If you have referred a friend for an open position under the BYB Scheme and she/he is hired you’ll receive a very attractive cash award.
• Connect globally 🌏 - Work with people from all over the world. You can feel the multicultural workforce.
• Benefit from being a TCSer 🎟️ – By being part of the TCS Spain family you can enjoy benefits, offers and corporate discounts on the best brands.
• And so on 🎉 - Appreciations, incentives, Team Building activities, diversity and inclusion programs, sustainability activities, corporative events... This has only just begun!

💡 WHO ARE WE?

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an Information Technology (IT) company founded in 1968 as part of the Indian Tata Group and is one of the top 3 technology companies globally 🚀

With a presence in 55 countries and more than 615,000 employees, TCS is considered one of the 10 best companies to work for worldwide in 2024 according to the Top Employers Institute 🥇

TCS Spain started operations in 2001 and currently has a diverse workforce that collaborates with the main Spanish and multinational companies 🌏

TCS Spain has been certified as a Top Employer 2024 and has also been chosen as one of the 100 Best Companies to Work for in Spain in 2023 according to Forbes 🏆

Among the portfolio of services, TCS has information technology services, asset-based solutions, global consulting, engineering and industrial services, digital solutions and services, application maintenance and development, quality assurance and testing services, IT infrastructure and BPS 🎯

Responsible for development, TCS Spain is committed to inclusion, diversity and sustainability, and promotes flexibility policies that support wellbeing and work-life balance 💯

WELCOME, WE ARE WAITING FOR YOU! 🚀

jobs_results.title: Junior Python Developer (Internship)
jobs_results.description:
🚀 ¡Únete a Capitole Consulting, donde el talento es nuestra principal prioridad! 🚀

¿Por qué Capitole Consulting?

🤝 En Capitole Consulting, creemos en un enfoque humano, donde nuestros empleados son lo primero. Ponemos a las personas en el centro de nuestra empresa.

👨💻 Te ofrecemos proyectos emocionantes y tecnologías de vanguardia en un entorno de metodologías ágiles.

🚀 Nuestra baja tasa de rotación y la felicidad de nuestros empleados son testamento de nuestro ambiente de trabajo positivo.

👛 Te ofrecemos un presupuesto anual de 1200€ para formación a medida, para que puedas seguir creciendo profesionalmente.

🕓 Con un horario flexible y la opción de trabajo remoto, te ayudamos a conciliar tu vida personal y laboral.

🌏 Formamos un equipo diverso de más de 900 profesionales, provenientes de hasta 27 nacionalidades diferentes.

🎯 Ofrecemos una trayectoria profesional a medida, con seguimiento mensual y evaluaciones 360° que incluyen revisión salarial.

🩺 Cuidamos de ti... con un seguro médico privado y opciones de retribución flexible.

🦾 Beneficios adicionales como acceso al plan Andjoy (Gymforless) y descuentos en grandes marcas a través del Club Capitole.

👥 Fomentamos la colaboración y el intercambio de conocimientos a través de comunidades tecnológicas y eventos regulares.

¡Capitole Consulting sigue creciendo y queremos que formes parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Qué buscamos?

Estamos en la búsqueda de un Back-end Developer Python Junior para un emocionante proyecto con un cliente líder digital en la industria química.

En este rol, pasarás a formar parte de un proyecto en el que te incorporarás a un programa de formación intensivo dentro del equipo de Plataforma de Ciencia de Datos. Serás responsable de capacitar a las entidades comerciales para aprovechar al máximo los datos y lograr los objetivos empresariales. Desarrollarás soluciones digitales innovadoras, crearás emocionantes experiencias para los clientes y el crecimiento empresarial, y mejorarás la eficiencia en los procesos.

Funciones principales y descripción del proyecto:

Profundizarás tus conocimientos en las últimas tecnologías en áreas como Cloud Computing, Big Data, Analítica e Inteligencia Artificial, aplicándolas en un entorno profesional para ayudar a los equipos a crear soluciones de TI para toda la compañía.

Requisitos Imprescindibles:
• Son bienvenidos recién graduados o personas con un mínimo de 6 meses de experiencia en desarrollo con Python y máximo de 2 años de experiencia laboral.
• Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Datos, Desarrollo de Backend o disciplina estrechamente relacionada.
• Capacidad y experiencia con bases de datos (preferible Postgres o HANA).
• Capacidad y experiencia en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones con Python.
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita en inglés.
• Jugador de equipo con alta disposición para aprender, una actitud positiva, así como experiencia trabajando en equipos globales y diversos.

Requisitos Deseables:
• Capacidad y experiencia en Cloud DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
• Conocimientos sobre Infraestructura como Código (IaC), preferiblemente Terraform.
• Idiomas: Inglés nivel C1.

¡Si crees que encajas con esta descripción o conoces a alguien que pueda hacerlo, no dudes en enviarnos tu perfil!

Para conocer más sobre nosotros y lo que opinan nuestros empleados, visita nuestro sitio web y perfil en Glassdoor.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo y juntos seremos imparables! 💼💡

Who we are 👇 https://capitole-consulting.com/ https://capitole-consulting.com/game

jobs_results.description:
“Cuidar de las personas y empresas para hacer del mundo un lugar más seguro, manteniéndonos a la vanguardia de la innovación” es lo que nos motiva desde hace más de 40 años.

Y lo hacemos utilizando las tecnologías más punteras (IA, IoT, Data Science, Blockchange, etc.) para ofrecer soluciones disruptivas a través de nuestras cinco líneas de negocio: Security, Cash, Alarms, Cipher y AVOS. Como un verdadero equipo, nuestros más de 150.000 profesionales han conseguido posicionarnos como un referente a nivel global en el sector de la seguridad privada estando presentes en más de 25 países. La innovación y la capacidad para transformarnos forman parte de nuestro ADN y compartimos tres valores que nos caracterizan: Nos importan las personas, pensamos en positivo y somos imparables.

Cipher es una empresa global de ciberseguridad que presta una amplia variedad de servicios. Entre sus clientes se encuentran desde empresas de tamaño medio hasta empresas de fama internacional y agencias... gubernamentales, con innumerables casos de éxito.

¿Y tú? ¿Te sientes identificado con nuestro propósito? ¿Te apasionan los retos y quieres llevar tu carrera profesional a otro nivel? Hoy tienes la oportunidad de hacerlo sumándote a nuestro Team of Teams como Desarrollador/a Senior.

Necesitamos una persona con inquietudes técnicas, que le guste estar siempre actualizado en las tendencias del mercado y nuevas soluciones de ciberseguridad.

¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?

-Experiencia en desarrollo dentro de entornos cloud ( Azure)

- Desarrollo de APIs (REST)

- Solidos conocimientos en lenguajes como Python y JavaScript.

- Experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones internas de automatización, despliegues y de escalabilidad ( Azure Devops, Jekins)

- Autenticación y securización

- Más de 3 años en proyectos completos de backend junto a base de datos (PostgreSql, MySQL, Oracle, etc), conexión con proxys, endpoints, etc

¿Qué buscamos de ti?
• Estudios superiores : Grado, Ingeniería o similares.
• 1- 3 años de experiencia
• Se valorará de forma positiva masters o certificaciones vinculadas con el área de ciberseguridad.
• Soft Skills: Habilidades de comunicación, gestión del tiempo, resolución de problemas, toma de decisiones y trabajo en equipo

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Formar parte de un equipo internacional.
• Teletrabajo 100%.
• Trabajar en un entorno dinámico con un excelente ambiente laboral.
• Crecer profesionalmente atendiendo a un plan carrera personalizado.
• Acceder a un plan formativo de primer nivel gracias a la Universidad Corporativa de Prosegur
• Disponer de flexibilidad horaria, teletrabajo e interesantes beneficios sociales ( Retribución flexible, beneficios corporativos, cashback..)
• Disfrutar de nuestro Programa Global de Bienestar.
• Participar en proyectos estratégicos y disruptivo.
• Colaborar con nuestra Fundación para crear una sociedad más justa.
• Dar vida a tus ideas en nuestro Programa Global de Innovación e Intraemprendimiento

Si quieres unirte a nuestro equipo en Cipher, ¡aplica a esta vacante para comenzar tu aventura con nosotros! Estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de Python
jobs_results.description:
About us:

Nnergix is an innovative company composed of professionals from the renewable energy industry with extensive knowledge in energy, data analytics, software, and in meteorology. Nnergix’s main focus is to develop software solutions for the power industry players which are leading the transition from fossil fuels technologies to clean energy sources.

Nnergix has a clear global focus as it currently has clients in 19 countries. In recent years it has been recognized as one of the most innovative SMEs in Europe.

Position overview:

We are looking for a Python Developer to work on developing, testing and maintaining several python packages and tools used for data analytics. The ideal candidate should have strong Python programming skills, as well as experience writing clean and robust code that can handle large amounts of data. Demonstrable experience with Python packages such as NumPy and Pandas is a plus.

The candidate should be comfortable working on open-ended projects... with an international team in evolving projects. Familiarity with data analysis techniques and scientific context is a great plus.

The candidate will be part of a highly motivated and experienced team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Front & Backend Developers and Scientists facing great technical challenges in the field of renewable energies. Hybrid analytical and data-driven methodologies will be applied using cutting-edge technologies to maximise the efficiency and robustness in the design of wind farms. There are multiple facets involved in this analysis requiring the usage of wind resource assessment, dynamic computational fluid dynamic models, and wake and blockage models. The challenge is to create a set of robust applications whilst maintaining the possibility of later incorporating them into a single seamless pipeline.

Preferred Qualifications:
• BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or similar disciplines.
• Experience with Python, specifically with data analysis libraries focused on time series processing. (pandas, xarray).
• Experience in building production-ready code by applying best practices (automated testing, CI/CD, clean code, Documentation, version control...).
• Experience in AWS, in particular with: S3, ECS, EKS, EC2.
• Used to work with agile development methodologies (Scrum)
• Experience with frameworks: FastAPI and/or Celery and/or Airflow and/or Dask
• Knowledge on Jenkins, git and dockers.
• Know and apply SOLID principles.
• Experience with version control tools and continuous integration.
• Being a “problem solver”, show proactivity, positive attitude and ability to work as part of a team.
• Expertise in the development of microservices based architecture.
• Good communication & analytical skills.
• Required fluency in Spanish and English, both spoken and written.

What we offer:
• Flexible working hours and optionally “work from home”.
• Competitive salary and a Permanent contract.
• A great, multicultural environment.
• Team building activities.
• Training courses: recurrent courses with a minimum equivalent of 5h per month oriented to ensure. best practices and solving technical challenges.
• Flexible Remuneration: choose your package according to your needs (restaurant, transportation, kindergarten, medical insurance).
• Full remote: possibility to work from home, or wherever you like, under the acceptance of your manager.
• Contribute towards a global energy model based on renewables with your work.
• Being part of a high qualified team in a young, dynamic and self-managed team. A lovely work environment in an ever-growing company
